items.source: Configure the characters dots potentially contained in a Map shall be replaced with. By default, we don't do any translation but rather reject a Map with keys containing dots causing the conversion for the entire object to fail. If further customization of the translation is needed, have a look at potentiallyEscapeMapKey(String) as well as potentiallyUnescapeMapKey(String).
items.translation: 配置中，Map 可能包含的字符点号将被替换为。默认情况下，我们不会进行任何翻译，而是拒绝键中包含点号的 Map，从而导致整个对象的转换失败。如果需要进一步自定义翻译，请查看potentiallyEscapeMapKey(String)以及potentiallyUnescapeMapKey(String)。
